_note: Expansion 4.2 thermal. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Every item marked VERIFY is an assumption from docs/fw_4_2_thermal.md section 5. Path specs: {key, rel} -> path_for(key)/rel, {exp, rel} -> expansion folder. Change freely.

clearings._schema: Polygon layer, EPSG:6346, columns clearing_id (unique), clearing_type (landing|corridor|field_edge|other), optional age_band. VERIFY. The annotated non-pad disturbance layer name is not confirmed (framework section 14)

audit_blocks._schema: Frozen P2 audit CSV (# header, sha256 sidecar), read only through ek.require_audit. block_id are P2 integer ids, mapped to bx_by with inputs.blocks. Missing file refuses unless --allow-no-audit, then the output is labelled exploratory

folds._schema: CSV block_id, fold (from the 3.0 scorer transfer_blocks.csv). VERIFY. Without it T4 refuses unless --fallback-folds

blocks._schema: 9t block layer 'blocks' with block_id = iy*12+ix, ix, iy (375 m from 619500, 4593000)

t0_routes._note: gas leaves near ground temperature, no temperature term at ordinary rates (framework T0)

sensors.name: landsat_tirs
sensors._verify: Native 100 m, delivered 30 m, ST_B10 scale 0.00341802 and offset 149.0 K from the Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 guide. Not yet read. VERIFY
sensors._qa_verify: Landsat Collection 2 QA_PIXEL bits 0 fill, 1 dilated cloud, 2 cirrus, 3 cloud, 4 cloud shadow, 5 snow. Stack QA_PIXEL as band 2 of each scene GeoTIFF. VERIFY against the USGS Collection 2 Level 2 Science Product Guide

sensors.name: ecostress
sensors._verify: About 70 m (LP DAAC ECO2LSTE.002 guide, not yet read). VERIFY
sensors._qa_verify: ECOSTRESS LSTE QC bits 0-1 mandatory flag, 0 best, 1 nominal, 2 cloud, 3 not produced. Stack QC as band 3 (LST 1, LST_err 2). VERIFY against the ECO2LSTE user guide for the collection version used. lst_scale 1.0 assumes an already scaled delivery (AppEEARS GeoTIFF). The raw product stores LST as uint16 with scale 0.02. The plausibility check in T2 refuses a wrong choice

_scene_index_schema: CSV scene_id, sensor, datetime_utc (ISO), path (GeoTIFF, LST band per sensor config), cloud_frac (0-1 over the block), qc_pass (bool), optional lst_err_K. Each scene GeoTIFF must carry the per-pixel QA band named by qa_band. Scenes without tie points passing T1 registration are not extracted
_tiepoints_schema: CSV scene_id, dx_m, dy_m (scene minus lidar edge position, metres)

gate._delta_T_note: User decision, proposed default 1.0 K (framework section 3). Fix before T1
gate._proxy_note: Pad minus matched clearing surface difference before dilution. null means not yet measured. The gate then reports only the break-even dT = delta_T / median fill
gate._max_undefined_note: T3 bootstrap. 0 as for T4. 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely

contrast._sign_note: Preregistered sign of pad minus clearing. +1 means pads warmer. User decision

added_value._delta_gain_note: Useful gain 0.03 recall at K. 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely
added_value._max_undefined_note: Share of bootstrap draws allowed to be undefined. 0 means any undefined draw gives an undefined interval and an inconclusive verdict (SH-01). 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely

primary_gate._note: Holm over the declared primaries only (T3, T4), one-sided at alpha / 2 per family, in _thermal_primary_holm_9t.py. Secondaries are reported, never gated. 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely

_t4_population_note: T4 unmatched population is pads and clearings only. Forest controls stay out. 2026-11-06 user accepted default ("take defaults"). Change freely
